scope: offline Meta-HPO and Meta-feature-selection shortlist only; no score, admission, portfolio, live, or exchange authority

objective.name: GateProxy_P0_Ridge
objective.meaning: Relative predicted downstream benefit of a Meta trial to the frozen dual-MC1 +50-bps gate, trained on matched strict-OOF six-month MC1 replays
objective.score_interpretation: relative shortlist rank only; it is not a bps estimate, live feature, admission threshold, or promotion decision

ground_truth_contract.mc1: separate six-complete-month Current and BCF maps; prior-21-day resolved shift; policy labels joined only after target-free scores
ground_truth_contract.gate: real dual Current MC1 >= +50 bps and BCF MC1 >= +50 bps
ground_truth_contract.priority: fixed BCF MC1 coordinate; Meta changes only the Current/gate coordinate
ground_truth_contract.label: reliability-shrunk weekly-block-bootstrap downstream gate benefit; portfolio metrics are confirmation only

selection_protocol.support_aware_model_choice: maximum minimum grouped-holdout Spearman, then mean across target family, loss, feature contract, and era
selection_protocol.selection_proposal: top 3 predicted GateProxy trials, plus one high-surrogate-disagreement exploration and one diverse descriptor control when a new MC1 batch is budgeted
selection_protocol.expensive_confirmation: every proposed trial must receive a fresh strict matched six-month MC1 replay before any advancement
selection_protocol.feature_selection: rank feature additions/removals/swaps by Delta GateProxy_P0, but confirm the top alternatives through fresh MC1
selection_protocol.priority_proxy: diagnostic only; it has no HPO authority

portability_evidence.selection_note: P0 Ridge wins maximin support-qualified Spearman (0.519820) over P3 Pairwise (0.462362). P3 has the higher mean (0.632907 versus 0.607041), but is not selected under the frozen maximin rule.
portability_evidence.f128_status: F128 has six independently MC1-labelled trials and therefore participates in feature-contract portability selection. Six trials is the predeclared minimum support, not proof of universal F128 superiority.

forbidden: Automatic Meta-trial promotion from a GateProxy score
Use of any proxy output as a live trading, admission, portfolio, or execution input
Use of portfolio PnL alone as a proxy training target
Use of PriorityProxy for HPO authority
